question.prompt: In cyclic quadrilateral \(ABCD\), extend \(BC\) to point \(E\). Given \(\angle DCE=80^\circ\), find \(\angle A\) in degrees.

solutions.explanation: An exterior angle equals its opposite interior angle, so \(\angle A=\angle DCE=80^\circ\). (This can also be obtained from \(\angle BCD=100^\circ\) and the fact that opposite angles are supplementary.)
solutions.title: Exterior angle of a cyclic quadrilateral
